name: English Minor
faculty: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences

sections.title: Program Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: An English minor must complete at least 28 units of English courses, including.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: 12 units of lower division English courses, at least six of which must be at the 100 level and at least six of which must be at the 200 level; and 16 units of upper division English courses, at least four of which must be at the 400 level (excluding any directed studies courses, i.e., ENGL 490 and 491).

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students must maintain at least a 2.00 grade point average in English courses.

sections.note: No courses from other departments may be substituted for this program's English courses.

caveats: Converted automatically from the calendar; confirm with an advisor.
